Help.noMatches: No matches found. Try another keyword.

Help.slowApp: App is slow or not loading?
Help.slowHelp: Refresh the page, check your connection, and try again with the latest browser version.
Help.notificationsHelp: Review notification permissions in Settings and in your device or browser settings.
Help.locationHelp: Confirm location permission is enabled and that sharing has been turned on for your accepted partner.

Help.contactCopy: Send a message through the support link for issues, setup help, or feature requests.
faqs: How do I invite my partner?
Open the couple-linking flow from the app or dashboard and share the invite link with your partner.
Can I use this app offline?
The app includes PWA support and a service worker, so key pages can remain available when your connection is weak.
How do I change the theme?
Use the theme panel in Settings or the quick theme control in the sidebar to switch between moods.
Where do I find wellness activities?
Open the Wellness tab from the home navigation, where the board collection is grouped in themed sections.
Go to the Memories page and click the upload button to add photos with captions and dates to your timeline.
Authenticated access and couple-scoped data policies are used to protect your shared content.
How do I export my data?
Go to Settings and use the Export button in the data section to download available account data.
How does the AI assistant work?
The AI assistant can help with relationship advice, date ideas, and love letters. Choose a tool and submit only the details you want to share.
